# Cartan-Leray　`thm.cartan-leray`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=thm.cartan-leray)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./thm.cartan-leray.md)

**How the proof goes**: take the sieve $\mathfrak{X}$ generated by $R$, then $\Gamma(\mathfrak{X}, M) = \Gamma(R, \mathcal{H}(M))$; $\mathcal{H}$ preserves injectives, so the Grothendieck spectral sequence plus the previous item gives the result.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
